item.title: Brisk temperatures to give way to warmer days ahead
item.description: After the coldest day of the season, temperatures are expected to rise over the next few days, with highs in the 40s and 50s and a chance of light rain on Thursday.

item.title: Former news anchor and Silver Dollar City PR Director dies at age 64
item.description: Lisa Rau, former Ozarks news anchor and Silver Dollar City Director of Public Relations, passed away at the age of 64, leaving behind a legacy of dedication to the Ozarks community and the City of Branson.

item.title: "It didn't look good": Mahomes exits late with knee injury, MRI pending
item.description: Patrick Mahomes left Sunday's game against the Chargers with a hyperextended knee, and an MRI will determine the extent of the injury, with early concerns including a potential ACL tear that could sideline him for 8 to 12 months.
